text:
sam (SE): Quick sync — Zenith Health wants a 3-week POC starting next Tue. They asked for committed throughput numbers + reserved GPU pricing, and they added a security note about KMS/HSM.

maria (AE): thanks. Do we have a recommended pack size for 10k qps-at-1k tokens/day typical profile?

devon (Solutions): for that shape I'd suggest reserved pool of 4xA40-like nodes with autoscale headroom to +2. baseline should handle 95th percentile.

sam (SE): can we justify 4 reserved vs 2 reserved + burst credits? they want cost delta for committed pricing.

maria (AE): they pushed back on burst because finance needs predictable run rate. so reserved pricing preferred, but we need a fallback plan for AZ eviction.

anya (Security): flagged items from their questionnaire: KMS integration required, option for customer-managed keys, SOC2 evidence, and data residency in eu-west-1. also asked about HSM for key wrapping.

devon (Solutions): ok on kms + CMK support. For HSM we support partner HSM via BYOK, but that's an enterprise add-on — need legal signoff. note: private deployment or Dedicated with VPC simplifies the residency ask.

sam (SE): ops question — autoscale policy we propose: min=4, target-util=65%, max=6, cool-down=120s. does that align with preheat plan?

devon (Solutions): yes. add prewarm job that issues KV-warmup requests on model startup. ex snippet: ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 6
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.65
prewarm:
  kv_warmup: true
  concurrency: 8
  throttle_ms: 50
```

maria (AE): can you give me a short bullets cost delta for 4 vs 6 reserved nodes and for reserved+burst combo? finance will want monthly numbers.

devon (Solutions): rough back-of-envelope: 4 reserved ~= $X/mo, 6 reserved ~= $1.45X/mo. 2 reserved + burst (credits) ~= $0.9X/mo but with 25% higher tail latency risk and queuing during surge. i'll run the exact calc.

anya (Security): also need to confirm audit log retention for Dedicated vs Hosted. they require 12 months logs and signed attestations. is that included?

sam (SE): Dedicated has longer retention add-on. Hosted standard is 90 days. We'll need to quote the enterprise compliance pack.

maria (AE): timeline: exchange questionnaire answers by EOD Fri, propose pricing + reservation options by Mon, and start POC infra deploy Tue. can we meet that?

devon (Solutions): yes — i'll draft the infra plan with prewarm job, KV warmup script, and a smoke test harness (synthetic traffic ramp: 0 -> 10k rps over 15m).

sam (SE): for the smoke test, can you include a tail-latency capture (p95/p99) and token-cost report per model variant? they want cost per 1k responses at 512 tokens.

devon (Solutions): will do. sample command we'll run: ```bash
loadgen --target 10000 --ramp 900 --payload-template=chat_512.json --capture-tail=true --report=token_cost.csv
```

maria (AE): legal ask — is there a standard addendum for HSM/BYOK and for reserved capacity credits? forward legal the questionnaire now.

anya (Security): I'll draft security answers for KMS, BYOK, and log retention. ping me for anything that needs evidence attachments.

sam (SE): ops_bot can you open an internal ticket for resource reservation and compliance quote? include link to this thread.

ops_bot: created ticket #SRV-8421 — "Zenith POC: reserved pool + security pack" assigned to devon, due 2026-04-02. :white_check_mark:

maria (AE): perfect. I'll update the customer and ask for any additional workload examples.

sam (SE): thanks team. I'll add the KV prewarm script to the ticket.

devon (Solutions): one more caveat — when they use quantized 8-bit runtime we estimate ~1.6x throughput per GPU; pricing should reflect binning for quantized vs full-precision. I'll add that to the pricing note.

maria (AE): noted. End of thread.
